title: Turin Massacre (1864)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Turin Massacre (1864)", at revision 1358233691, opens: "The Turin Massacre was a massacre carried out by members of the Royal Italian Army on 21 and 22 September 1864 against groups of civilian demonstrators. The clashes occurred during popular protests against the transfer of the capital of the Kingdom of Italy from the Piedmontese city to Florence." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3975748, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Massacre occurred between September 21 and 22, 1864) in Turin.". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
